request.description: Protected (Admin): Update a teacher's basic user identity and faculty/designation profile information.
Protected: Administrator updates a user's operational status (ACTIVE, INACTIVE, BLOCKED). Automatically revokes active sessions if set to BLOCKED or INACTIVE. Admin self-blocking is rejected.
Protected: Administrator soft-deletes a user account (sets deletedAt timestamp, sets status to INACTIVE, revokes all sessions). Admin self-deletion is strictly prevented.
Protected (Admin): Grant or update delegated administrative permissions (MANAGE_ATTENDANCE, MANAGE_EXAMS, MANAGE_ROUTINES) for a specific teacher.
Protected: Administrator creates a new academic batch with name, fee, and status. Sets batchId in environment.

query.description: Filter by status: UPCOMING, ONGOING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED

request.description: Protected: Authenticated users list batches with universal QueryBuilder filtering, search, and pagination.
Protected: Retrieves single batch details with routine schedule and enrolled student counters.
Protected: Administrator updates batch name, fee, or operational status.
Protected: Administrator soft-deletes batch (sets deletedAt timestamp and updates status to CANCELLED).
Protected: Active student requests enrollment into a batch. Creates enrollment record in PENDING state awaiting admin approval.

item.name: ✅ Get Pending Enrollment Requests (Admin Only — QueryBuilder)

query.description: Search student name, email, phone or batch name

request.description: Protected: Administrator retrieves all pending student enrollment applications across all batches using QueryBuilder.
Protected: Administrator approves student enrollment, setting status to ENROLLED and approvedAt timestamp.
Protected: Administrator rejects student enrollment request, setting status to REJECTED.
Protected: Administrator directly adds an active student into a batch (immediately ENROLLED with approvedAt timestamp).

query.description: Filter by enrollment status: ENROLLED, PENDING, REJECTED

request.description: Protected: Administrator and Teacher view paginated roster of students in a specific batch with student & guardian details.
Protected: Administrator drops / removes a student from a batch enrollment.
Protected: Authenticated student views their enrolled batches, fee amounts, and class timetable routines.

item.name: ✅ Create Routine Slot (Admin or Authorized Teacher)

request.description: Protected: Admin or Teacher with MANAGE_ROUTINES creates a class routine slot with room, teacher, and batch conflict validation.

query.description: Search subject, room, teacher name, or batch name

request.description: Protected: Authenticated user lists routine slots with universal QueryBuilder search, filters, and pagination.
Protected: Retrieves single routine slot details with assigned faculty and batch metadata.
Protected: Retrieves complete day-grouped weekly schedule (SATURDAY through FRIDAY) for a specific batch.
Protected: Administrator or Teacher retrieves full teaching schedule for a specific teacher.
Protected: Authenticated teacher retrieves their personal weekly teaching schedule grouped by day.
Protected: Authenticated student retrieves aggregated weekly class timetable across all their active batch enrollments.

item.name: ✅ Update Routine Slot (Admin or Authorized Teacher)

request.description: Protected: Updates routine slot parameters with conflict validation excluding current slot.

item.name: ✅ Delete Routine Slot (Admin or Authorized Teacher)

request.description: Protected: Deletes routine slot and releases room / teacher assignment.

item.name: ✅ Download/Preview Batch Routine Schedule PDF (All Roles)

request.description: Dynamically streams an official weekly class schedule timetable PDF in A4 format with zero cloud storage usage. Set download=true for file attachment download or download=false for inline browser rendering.

item.name: ✅ Daily Attendance Tracking
✅ Mark Bulk Daily Attendance (Admin or Authorized Teacher)

request.description: Protected (Admin / Authorized Teacher): Marks attendance for today in Bangladesh Standard Time (BST). Note: date field is optional and automatically defaults to today in BST. Past/future dates are rejected.

item.name: ✅ Get Batch Attendance Sheet (Admin or Authorized Teacher)

request.description: Protected: Retrieves paginated attendance records and aggregated statistics (present/absent/late counts & attendance rate) for a batch on a specific date or date range.

item.name: ✅ Update Single Attendance Record (Admin or Authorized Teacher)

request.description: Protected (Admin / Authorized Teacher): Corrects an attendance record for today in Bangladesh Standard Time (BST). Previous days' records cannot be modified (view-only).

item.name: ✅ Get Student Attendance History (Admin or Authorized Teacher)

request.description: Protected: Retrieves full attendance history and overall attendance percentage for a specific student across all batches.
Protected: Student self-service endpoint to view their own attendance history and aggregate attendance rate.

item.name: ✅ Get My Teacher Attendance Summary (Teacher Only)

request.description: Protected: Teacher retrieves their own attendance history and aggregate statistics.

item.name: ✅ Mark Bulk Teacher Attendance (Admin or Authorized Teacher)

request.description: Protected (Admin / Authorized Teacher): Marks faculty attendance for today in Bangladesh Standard Time (BST). Note: date field is optional and defaults to today in BST. Past/future dates are rejected.

item.name: ✅ Get Teacher Attendance Sheet (Admin or Authorized Teacher)

request.description: Protected: Retrieves paginated teacher attendance records and aggregate statistics (present, absent, late, leave counts & attendance rate).

item.name: ✅ Get Specific Teacher Attendance Summary (Admin or Authorized Teacher)

request.description: Protected: Retrieves full attendance history and statistics for a specific teacher.

item.name: ✅ Update Single Teacher Attendance Record (Admin or Authorized Teacher)

request.description: Protected (Admin / Authorized Teacher): Corrects a faculty attendance record for today in Bangladesh Standard Time (BST). Previous days' records cannot be modified (view-only).

item.description: Endpoints for bulk daily attendance marking, single-record audit-logged corrections, batch attendance statistical sheets, and student attendance self-service summaries.

item.name: ✅ Update Single Student Mark (Admin or Authorized Teacher)

request.description: Admin views the monthly roster of all enrolled students with batch fees, carry-over previous dues, paid amounts, remaining dues, and status.
Admin retrieves top dashboard metrics: Expected Revenue, Collected Amount, Total Due, Collection Rate percentage, and student payment counts.
Admin records an offline fee collection (Cash, bKash, Nagad, Bank Transfer) with partial or full payment support. Updates student bill balance immediately and issues a receipt.

item.name: ✅ Adjust Bill Previous Due Amount (Admin Only)

request.description: Protected: Admin manually adjusts the previous due (arrear balance) of a student's monthly fee bill. Recalculates total payable, remaining due, and status automatically inside an interactive transaction with an audit log.

item.name: ✅ Get Student Billing Summary & Dues (Student Only)

request.description: Student views their monthly billing summary across all active batches, itemizing current monthly fees, historical previous dues, and net total balance.
Student initiates a hosted Stripe Checkout Session for full remaining balance settlement.
Cryptographically verified Stripe webhook listener that fulfills transactions and marks bills as PAID.
Admin and Student view the payment transaction history with pagination and search.
